reason: The plugin is primarily a user-interface navigation enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web: it renders a right-side turn rail, keeps the active turn synced while scrolling, and can auto-display session history turns, as documented in the README. Manifest data confirms web-client injection and profile patching, with no evidence of data-processing, external-service, or automation/control-plane behavior beyond local conversation UI presentation.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在对话界面右侧提供可展开的回合导航轨道，用于快速定位和跳转历史聊天回合。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an expandable right-side turn rail in DeepSeek Harness Web to help users quickly navigate historical chat turns within a conversation session.

capabilities: Conversation turn navigation in chat sessions
Right-side rail marker display and expanded turn list
Scroll position sync (scrollspy) for active turn highlighting
Optional UI visual toggle in settings

reasons.code: README states the plugin provides a right-side turn navigation rail with per-user-turn markers and expandable panel for each turn.
Plugin manifest marks platform as web client UI and bundles via dsh client/runtime/injection patch, indicating frontend UI integration.
Repository tree includes UI client bundle, tests, and patch file with no backend services, file-system tools, or external-service modules.
